chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Uthman, from Salih ibn Abi al-Aswad, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said, and Masjid al-Sahla was mentioned, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'Indeed, it is the residence of our Master (al-Qaim) when he arises with his people.'

key_terms.إِذَا قَامَ: When he arises (referring to the rise of the Mahdi)
key_terms.صَاحِبُنَا: Our Master (referring to the Imam al-Qaim)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Masjid al-Sahla in Shia eschatology?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identifies Masjid al-Sahla as the future residence or encampment of Imam al-Qaim (the Mahdi) upon his rise, linking the site to the establishment of his global rule. This hadith underscores the eschatological significance of this specific location in Shia tradition, where it serves as a strategic and spiritual base for the Imam's movement. The designation reflects the continuity of divine guidance and the physical manifestation of justice in the end times.
